title: Multiplication of arbitrary homogeneous quotient sections
statement: Let j:Z→X be a closed immersion of schemes, L an O_X-module, and T a TensorGradedPresentation j L [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation]. For a,d≥0 and global sections s of j*L^a and t of j*L^d, c_a(s)c_d(t) equals c_(a+d) applied to the pullback of tensorPowAddIso inverse after boundaryPullbackTensorIso inverse applied to tmulSection(s,t) [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit, def-pc-module-pullback]. This is a statement about quotient multiplication independent of the block-degree section comparison.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and the direct-sum exact sequence following it; Tag 0B8S, cohomology-lemma-boundary-derivation-over-cup-product, the quotient action in the first paragraph of its proof.

proof.text: The closed-immersion adjunction unit on each tensor power is locally surjective: on stalks it is the quotient by the immersion ideal, transported by the unique adjunction comparison. Locally lift s and t through these units, refining their covers to a common cover. The equation b_quotient identifies their images under c with p applied to their b-images. Since p is an algebra morphism, their product is p applied to the product of those b-images. Apply b_multiply and b_quotient in degree a+d. Naturality and the monoidal adjunction comparison identify the image of the tensor product of the lifts with the tensor product of s and t transported through boundaryPullbackTensorIso. This proves the displayed equality on the common cover; sheaf separation proves it globally. The argument also works in degree zero, where tensorPowAddIso and the pullback tensor comparison use the unitors.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorGradedQuotient_multiply {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) (T : TensorGradedPresentation j L)
    (a d : ℕ) (s : Γ((tensorPullback j).obj (L.tensorPow a), ⊤))
    (t : Γ((tensorPullback j).obj (L.tensorPow d), ⊤)) :
    tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.C ⊤ ((T.c a).app ⊤ s) *
      tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.C ⊤ ((T.c d).app ⊤ t) =
      tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.C ⊤ ((T.c (a + d)).app ⊤
        (((tensorPullback j).map (L.tensorPowAddIso a d).inv).app ⊤
          ((boundaryPullbackTensorIso j (L.tensorPow a) (L.tensorPow d)).inv.app ⊤
            (tmulSection s t))))
